owner_direction: Distinct stone paving, gravel fill, compacted earth and forest tracks appropriate to connected streets, squares, homes, work and fields. Raised graded embankments/shoulders remain open.
problem: Thin visual path overlays previously stood 25-45 mm above authoritative physical terrain. Feet supported by that terrain could be buried by the painted surface. Close actual frames also showed oversized gravel detail.
changes: Constrain shared terrain path overlays to 6-12 mm above the same physical 4 m terrain triangles. Main roads use 6 mm, village lanes/gate approaches 8 mm, home/garden paths 10 mm, market paving 12 mm. Forest track/ruts retain separate 7/9 mm layers; cultivated soil uses 6 mm.

Preserve village street-versus-paving feedback priority. Separate town crossroad/main-road layers by 1 mm; retain existing geography, homes, gate and interaction IDs, terrain collision and save schema.

Reuse the same unmodified CC0 gravel diffuse, with world texture frequency 3.0 rather than .65; individual gravel detail is about 4.6 times smaller. Stone paving and soil retain their distinct scales, generated mipmaps and anisotropic filtering.

Strengthen the existing mandatory terrain-path test: actual dedicated reference terrain collision, 539 road rays plus 156 rays across 52 real village/garden/cart overlays. All three material kinds, chunk seams and 15 real entrance paths remain required.

Extend the existing graphical village journey with naturally settled Idle, final-modifier snapshots of all 3530 native boot vertices, actual physical ray support and top visible path layer, plus a close road/boots capture. No actor coordinate assignment or forced animation pose.
